name: 2025-1c-recuperatorio
title: Fleet Escape! (Escape de Flota!)
description: Starting from the Spanish solution of the first midterm (fleet of ships with thrusters crossing galactic sectors), add: a tank that cracks under gravity > 300 and leaks fuel exponentially, an overheating warp thruster, ship 'blink' that skips sectors, the stranded-sector index, and motherships that dock and refuel out-of-fuel ships with capacity, maneuverability and shield rules.

design.notes: The new rules are state changes of the ship (intact/cracked tank, warp overheated for two sectors, docked/undocked in a mothership) layered on an existing double dispatch between sectors and thrusters, so the challenge is adding them as state objects without multiplying the if cases; point 4 (a separate exam for those recovering the second midterm; points 1-3 are for the first) adds recursive composition (motherships inside motherships) with ordering and random choice.
